name: Dolný Kubín (Slovakia)
description: Ten equal horizontal stripes of white, white, red, red, white, white, red, red, white and white, ending at the fly in a swallowtail whose notch reaches one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature D-3/91.
